rumbleCut.name: Rumble Cut
rumbleCut.description: Takes the room out from under a sound.

warmLowPass.name: Warm Low Pass
warmLowPass.description: Rolls the top off without dulling it.

squelch.name: Squelch
squelch.description: Close to self-oscillation, at the resonance the engine reaches.

ambience.name: Ambience
ambience.description: Glue rather than an effect you can hear.

plate.name: Plate
plate.description: Bright, short and wide, sitting behind the source.

doubler.name: Doubler
doubler.description: Too short to hear as an echo; it widens instead.

warmDrive.name: Warm
warmDrive.description: A little weight, and no obvious distortion.

fuzz.name: Fuzz
fuzz.description: All the way, with the output pulled back to compensate.

parallelGrit.name: Parallel Grit
parallelGrit.description: Heavy distortion blended under the dry signal.

saturate.name: Saturate
saturate.description: Soft clip with the top rolled off - weight, not grit.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.description: Hard clipped and bright, with the output pulled back.

ringFold.name: Ring Fold
ringFold.description: A wavefolder past the point where it stops sounding like level.

subtleWiden.name: Subtle Widen
subtleWiden.description: Slow and shallow: stereo, rather than an effect.

vibrato.name: Vibrato
vibrato.description: Fully wet, which is what makes it vibrato and not chorus.

slowSweep.name: Slow Sweep
slowSweep.description: One notch pair crossing the mid, slowly enough to hear it move.

jetPhaser.name: Jet
jetPhaser.description: High feedback, high up: the notches whistle rather than sweep.

shimmer.name: Shimmer
shimmer.description: Fast and shallow, blended under the dry signal.

glue.name: Glue
glue.description: Two decibels at most, slow enough to leave the transients.

punch.name: Punch
punch.description: A slow attack lets the hit through and clamps what follows.

squash.name: Squash
squash.description: Fast and hard, for a level that does not move at all.

masterCeiling.name: Master Ceiling
masterCeiling.description: Just under full scale, and slow enough not to pump.

safetyNet.name: Safety Net
safetyNet.description: Set low enough that nothing but a mistake reaches it.

brickWall.name: Brick Wall
brickWall.description: Well into the signal, released fast: audibly held, and nothing above it.

air.name: Air
air.description: A lift above the top of the mix.

scoop.name: Scoop
scoop.description: Out of the way of a vocal.

warmPad.name: Warm Pad
warmPad.description: Three detuned voices under a slow attack.

subBass.name: Sub Bass
subBass.description: One sine an octave down, and nothing else.

pluck.name: Pluck
pluck.description: No sustain: the decay is the whole sound.

hollowKeys.name: Hollow Keys
hollowKeys.description: A square under a triangle an octave up.

morphingSweep.name: Morphing Sweep
morphingSweep.description: Five unison voices morphing across the table over the note.

loopedBed.name: Looped Bed
loopedBed.description: Loops with short fades at both ends, so the seam does not click.

reverseSwell.name: Reverse Swell
reverseSwell.description: Played backwards into a long fade in.

softenedFont.name: Softened
softenedFont.description: Slower on and off, and a little darker, for a font that starts too hard.

steppedFont.name: Stepped
steppedFont.description: Every note at full level and cut short, for playing a kit from the grid.

warning.midiDuplicateNotes: Overlapping clips played some notes twice; the duplicates were merged, so this file is slightly thinner than the audio.
warning.midiHeldOverNotes: Notes that began before the range are retriggered at its start. An audio render of the same range reproduces them mid-note instead.
warning.midiChannelsShared: This project has more than fifteen channels, so some share a MIDI channel.
warning.stemsDoNotSum: The master chain processes each stem, so the stems will not sum exactly back to the mix.
warning.stateNotAnObject: state: expected an object - using defaults
warning.scoreGridMismatch: the score needs a grid of {score, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} per beat and the project has {project}; changing it would alter playback speed, so nothing was written
warning.scoreMeterMismatch: the score is in {score} and the project is in {project}; changing the meter would move every existing clip, so nothing was written
